asset.Host - Tooltip: Hostname or IP address of the asset
asset.Network gateway - Tooltip: Connect to the asset through an SSH jump host or an agent in its network, for assets that Casvisor cannot reach directly
asset.Recorded on the first connection, a diff: Recorded on the first connection, a different host key or certificate is rejected afterwards. Clear it if the server was reinstalled or its certificate renewed

command.Pattern - Tooltip: A regular expression, matched anywhere in the command, for example ^\s*rm\s+-rf\s+/\s*$

networkGateway.A token is set. It was shown only once,: A token is set. It was shown only once, generate a new one if it is lost
networkGateway.An agent in the other network connects o: An agent in the other network connects out to Casvisor over HTTPS and keeps the connection open, Casvisor reaches the assets that use the gateway through it
networkGateway.Casvisor connects to the gateway over SS: Casvisor connects to the gateway over SSH and reaches the assets that use it from there, the gateway needs AllowTcpForwarding
networkGateway.No token yet, generate one and start the: No token yet, generate one and start the agent with it
networkGateway.One network (CIDR) or IP address per lin: One network (CIDR) or IP address per line, the agent refuses to connect anywhere else. Leave it empty to allow every address
networkGateway.Recorded on the first connection, a diff: Recorded on the first connection, a different host key is rejected afterwards. Clear it if the gateway was reinstalled
networkGateway.The agent is disconnected right away and: The agent is disconnected right away and cannot connect again until a new token is generated
networkGateway.The agent using the current token is dis: The agent using the current token is disconnected and has to be started again with the new one
networkGateway.The token is shown only this once. Run t: The token is shown only this once. Run the command on a machine in the other network, with the casvisor binary of the same release

Assets are not restarted automatically. Restart them afterwards if an update needs it.
patch.Connections to the assets drop while the: Connections to the assets drop while they restart. Each asset is scanned again once it is back.
patch.No SSH assets yet. Add the SSH asset of: No SSH assets yet. Add the SSH asset of a machine to manage its updates.
patch.Nothing has run on this asset yet: Nothing has run on this asset yet

permission.Actions - Tooltip: Allowed operations: connect, copy, paste, upload and download. Other actions have no effect without Connect
permission.Asset tags - Tooltip: Applies to all assets with these tags, which work as asset groups
permission.Assets - Tooltip: Assets this permission applies to, All means every asset of the organization
permission.Client IPs - Tooltip: Only allow connections from these IPs or CIDRs, leave empty for any
permission.End time - Tooltip: The permission expires after this time, leave empty for no expiry
permission.Groups - Tooltip: Casdoor groups, applies to every user in them
permission.Is enabled - Tooltip: The permission has no effect when disabled
permission.Start time - Tooltip: The permission takes effect from this time, leave empty to start now
permission.Users - Tooltip: Casdoor user names, All means every user of the organization

sshKey.Add your public key below, then connect: Add your public key below, then connect with the asset name as the username
sshKey.Connecting with your own username shows: Connecting with your own username shows a menu of your SSH assets
sshKey.Paste the content of ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.p: Paste the content of ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub, or create a key with ssh-keygen -t ed25519
sshKey.The SSH gateway is not enabled, set sshG: The SSH gateway is not enabled, set sshGatewayPort in conf/app.conf to enable it

user.Leave empty to keep the password: Leave empty to keep the password
user.Password - Tooltip: At least 8 characters; leave it empty to keep the current password of an existing user
